name: Rajnandini Fashion India Ltd
tagline: Rs ~40-65 Cr BSE-SME women's ethnic / casual apparel micro-cap listed June 2026 -- reported ~43% ROE and ~23% EBITDA margin, but on a ~Rs 31 Cr revenue base with rising debtor days (73 -> 115), stretching working capital (76 -> 121 days) and D/E ~1.0
business_overview: Rajnandini Fashion India (BSE SME) designs, manufactures and sells women's apparel across ethnic and casual wear through B2C and B2B channels, pitched as a digital-first D2C ethnic-wear brand.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 31 Cr FY25 (~Rs 31 Cr also in 9M-FY26); up from ~Rs 24 Cr FY24
fundamentals_narrative: The return ratios and margins look strong in isolation, but this is a ~Rs 31 Cr-revenue micro-cap where the more telling signals are the balance-sheet trends: debtor days up from 73 to 115, working-capital days up from 76 to 121, and debt-to-equity near 1.0. Rising receivables alongside flat-to-modest revenue on a tiny base raises a channel / revenue-quality question. D2C women's ethnic wear is a crowded, low-barrier category; at this size there is no brand moat and limited pricing power.
